Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
3–10 groups; beyond that use Sankey or a matrix.
Ribbons at layer opacity (BND-09), never paint opacity.
Order groups to minimise crossings (largest next to its biggest partner).
Always provide the matrix as a table fallback.
Reading width
Ribbon width at each end is the flow in that direction: A → B at A’s arc, B → A at B’s arc.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
Field
Definition
Purpose
Two-way flows between groups: outer arcs show each group’s total, ribbons the flow between a pair. Focus colours one group’s ribbons and greys the rest.
Encoding
angle span = group total (outgoing), ribbon end width = directed flow, colour = group (categorical). Square matrix input.
Interaction
Hover arc / ribbon → tooltip, others fade. Click arc → Focus. Keyboard: arrows move between groups; Enter focuses.
Accessibility
aria-label with top 3 flows; matrix table fallback; Focus is also announced in text.
